I replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That number comes from Dana's own messages in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025, a channel she's in. She first wrote 180, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. Seat counts are operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed to share it.

I couldn't check it against the signed amendment. The share has no Quarrendon contract files I can open, so I told Dana that June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if the deck needs the contract checked.

gbrain refused every search because its connection isn't linked to any member, so nothing was read from it. An admin on the brain host would need to run something like:

    gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member '<MEMBER>'

or set it up as a shared agent with --may-act-for, naming the member on each request.
